messages:
From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@scaleflow.ai>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-12T09:15:00Z
Subject: Interested in Dedicated capacity demo — high-throughput use case

Hi team,

I signed up through the demo flow this morning and wanted to share a bit more context before we chat. We're ScaleFlow (fintech analytics), currently running an in-house text-enrichment pipeline that peaks at ~300 requests/sec during market open and we need p95 generation latency under ~75ms. We're evaluating Dedicated capacity for predictable throughput and isolation.

Can someone confirm whether Redwood Dedicated can hit that latency envelope with ~300 rps and guide on next steps for a short technical demo? We have a POC readiness window next week (Apr 14–16).

Thanks,
Olivia
Olivia Park
Head of Platform
ScaleFlow Inc.
[phone: +1 415-555-0192]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@scaleflow.ai>
Date: 2027-04-12T10:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Interested in Dedicated capacity demo — high-throughput use case

Hi Olivia — thanks for signing up and for the useful context. I'm Jonas on the Redwood sales/solutions team. Quick answers up front: Dedicated is designed for predictable throughput and isolation; the latency you mention (p95 < 75ms at 300 rps) is achievable depending on model choice, sequence lengths, and batching strategy — that's exactly what we'd prototype in a short technical demo.

Two quick asks so we can tailor the session:
- Can you confirm the model family you expect to use (e.g., Llama2 / Falcon / mix)?
- Typical input length and average/peak token output (tokens per request)?

Suggested times (PDT):
- Wed Apr 14, 10:00–10:30 PT
- Wed Apr 14, 14:00–14:30 PT
- Thu Apr 15, 09:00–09:30 PT

I've attached a short capacity intake form that helps us size the right Dedicated config. If none of those slots work, send me a Calendly link and I can adapt.

Attachments: [capacity-intake-form.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0102

From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@scaleflow.ai>

Hi Jonas — thanks for the quick reply and the intake form. Quick answers:
- Model: Primarily Llama2-13B (we may test smaller/quant).
- Input: average ~180 tokens, output ~120 tokens.
- Peak: 300 rps for a 30 min window; average 60–80 rps otherwise.

Of the times you suggested, Apr 14 at 10:00 PT works best for us. I'll accept an invite if you send one.

Also uploading a short sample payload and a small latency profile we collected (attached). Looking forward to it.

Olivia

Attachments: [sample-payloads.json (application/json), scaleflow-latency-snaps.txt (text/plain)]
